INSERT INTO provider_breaker (organization_id, type, name, state, until, backoff_ms,
                                           probe, changed_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
             ON CONFLICT (organization_id, type, name) DO UPDATE
                SET state = $4, until = $5, backoff_ms = $6, probe = $7, changed_at = $8
